title: DAL-P08 - Paper-candidate training freeze and required-system qualification foundation
outcome: Build a reproducible development-only training and real-system qualification foundation for the DAL paper candidate, matched clinical-encoder control, and Laya while P08 final-test access remains sealed.
rationale: SG-000018 closed the benchmark and pre-results protocol blockers but left all three authorization-critical systems pending. The current trainable GAX v0 is an engineering control rather than an adequate paper candidate, and the frozen PubMedQA role surface has no explicit train split. SG-000019 prospectively derives training only from the qualified development role and binds stronger model/checkpoint/real-execution evidence before any final-test inference.
scope_in: Deterministic nested 360-train/90-selection split derived only from the 450 qualified PubMedQA PQA-L development rows
Development-only split lineage, stratification, leakage checks, and canonical digest
DAL paper-candidate architecture/training/checkpoint provenance path using a frozen clinical encoder backbone and typed action scoring
Explicit evidence-sensitive representation path and information-sufficiency mechanism separated from the action distribution
Exact Laya checkpoint/model identity freeze and zero-founder-cost real-execution qualification path
Machine-readable training recipe, checkpoint, selection-history, hardware/runtime, and real-execution evidence manifests
Zero-founder-cost accelerator notebook/workflow for execution that cannot be completed on ordinary CI hardware
Fail-closed inventory mutation that cannot mark required systems qualified without immutable real-execution evidence
Exact-head cross-platform CI plus Alibaba OpenCodeReview and secure TypeSafe Jev review
scope_out: No use of calibration or final-test rows for training or development selection
No PQA-A or PQA-U use without separate immutable identity and rights qualification
No promotion of gax-bilinear-v0 to the headline paper model by convenience
No autoregressive answer generation in the DAL paper-candidate path
No final-test-derived checkpoint, threshold, prompt, ECAL, or FHIR representation selection
No clinical-safety, regulatory-readiness, deployment, superiority, or SOTA claim
No paid founder compute, API, SaaS, or reviewer requirement
No silent removal of Laya or other frozen required systems because execution is difficult
